messages:
lucy: Heads-up: onboarding sampleapp is spamming retries for a mix of 400s and 401s. Users get locked by rate limits and we lose observability into the root cause.

omar: do we have an example payload?

lucy: server returns things like: `{ "error": { "kind": "parse_error", "msg": "metadata expected object" }, "request_id": "req_abc123" }` and other cases: 401 with `error.kind = auth_error` but no machine code or retry guidance.

rita: two problems: (1) SDK maps many 4xx -> BadRequest, so client code retries blindly. (2) we don't include a stable `error.code` or `error_id` to correlate logs across the stack. Ops can't link sampleapp client logs to backend traces.

ci-bot: Created ticket DX-1201 (error-telemetry-and-typed-mapping) and linked infra issue RN-455.

omar: Proposal: server should emit standardized fields on error JSON: `code` (stable machine id e.g. ERR_PARSE_METADATA), `kind` (human class), `retriable` boolean, `help_url`, and `error_id` (unique per failure instance). Also include `request_id` in top-level response for tracing.

lucy: SDK adapters should: 1) map `code`/`kind` -> typed exceptions (ParseError, AuthError, ValidationError, RateLimitError), 2) surface `retriable` boolean and `help_url` on the error object, 3) attach `error_id` + `request_id` to the thrown error so apps can log them.

rita: Addendum: for auth_error specifically, add `credential_action` hint: one of `refresh`, `reauth`, `contact-admin`. That avoids coarse guidance like "auth failed".

omar: Telemetry change helps SRE: if SDK logs include `error_id` and `request_id`, we can crosslink on dashboards and quickly find traces. Also add a sample log line in SDK: `logger.warn('Request failed', { request_id, error_id, code, retriable })`.

lucy: UX note: sampleapp should show user-friendly copy with a help link and support token: `We couldn't parse your metadata (ERR_PARSE_METADATA). See /docs/onboarding#metadata or contact support with code ERR_PARSE_METADATA and request id req_abc123.` Keep UI concise.

rita: For retry semantics: sampleapp change from blanket retry to: `if (err.retriable) { retryWithBackoff(); } else { showError(); }` and log `retriable` false errors to Sentry as errors not warnings.

ci-bot: Action: linked DX-1201 to sampleapp PR template.

omar: Who will own SDK changes? I can do JS/TS, lucy will do Go. I'll add a small mapping table and unit tests. Key requirement: SDKs must not make new network calls in the mapping path (no extra fetch), just inspect body + headers.

lucy: I'll also add a thin helper `error.toLogEntry()` to return a serializable map with `request_id`, `error_id`, `code`, `message`, `retriable`. That keeps app logging consistent.

rita: CI: update mock server fixtures used by E2E to include `code` and `error_id`. Ops, please ensure load tests don't emit synthetic `error_id` collisions.

omar: timeline: server-side agreement this week; SDK PRs next week. I'll draft SDK change with tests and the sampleapp update in the same week.

lucy: small migration note for integrators: if you relied on string-matching against error messages, switch to `err.code` and `err.retriable`. We'll include a migration guide in the changelog.

rita: nice. This should make retries explicit and make support debugging much faster. :rocket:

devrel: I'll prepare a short 'what to expect' blurb for the onboarding README and the release notes, including an example mapping table for common error codes.

lucy: thanks — please @devrel when PRs are ready so we can coordinate docs + SDK changelog.

ci-bot: Noted: DX-1201 assigned to omar/lucy/rita.
